import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import comment


def test_sv4sec01_boundary():
    e = ET.fromstring(comment.render('a & b', 'line1\nline2'))
    p = e.find('p')
    assert e.find('h3').text == 'a & b' and p.text == 'line1'
    assert len(p.findall('br')) == 1 and p.find('br').tail == 'line2'

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import link


def test_sv4sec02_compositional():
    e = ET.fromstring(link.render('https://x.dev/a?b=1&c=2', 'Docs'))
    assert e.get('href') == 'https://x.dev/a?b=1&c=2' and e.get('rel') == 'noopener noreferrer'
    assert e.text == 'Docs' and e.get('data-blocked') is None

def test_sv4sec02_negative():

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import link


def test_sv4sec02_boundary():
    rel = ET.fromstring(link.render('/local', '<b>'))
    assert rel.get('href') == '/local' and rel.text == '<b>' and rel.get('data-blocked') is None
    assert ET.fromstring(link.render('MAILTO:a@b.c', 'm')).get('href') == 'MAILTO:a@b.c'
